policies.using:
((app_role() = 'admin'::text) OR (app_role() = 'teacher'::text) OR ((app_role() = 'student'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM students s
  WHERE ((s.id = current_ref()) AND (s.cls = examschedule.cls) AND ((examschedule.sec IS NULL) OR (examschedule.sec = s.sec)))))) OR ((app_role() = 'parent'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (parent_student_links psl
     JOIN students s ON ((s.id = psl.student_id)))
  WHERE ((psl.parent_auth_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (psl.status = 'active'::text) AND (s.cls = examschedule.cls) AND ((examschedule.sec IS NULL) OR (examschedule.sec = s.sec)))))))

   FROM (timetable_entries te
     JOIN batch_students bs ON ((bs.batch_id = te.batch_id)))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.announcement_visible(p_target text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select case
    when public.app_role() = 'admin' then true
    when lower(coalesce(p_target,'all')) in ('all','everyone') then public.app_role() in ('student','parent','teacher')
    when lower(p_target) in ('student','students') then public.app_role() = 'student'
    when lower(p_target) in ('parent','parents') then public.app_role() = 'parent'
    when lower(p_target) in ('teacher','teachers') then public.app_role() = 'teacher'
    when lower(p_target) like 'batch:%' then
      case public.app_role()
        when 'student' then public.student_can_access_batch(split_part(p_target,':',2), public.current_ref())
        when 'teacher' then public.teacher_can_access_batch(split_part(p_target,':',2), public.current_ref())
        when 'parent' then exists (
          select 1
          from public.parent_student_links psl
          join public.batch_students bs on bs.student_id = psl.student_id and coalesce(bs.status,'active')='active'
          where psl.parent_auth_id = auth.uid()
            and psl.status='active'
            and bs.batch_id = split_part(p_target,':',2)
        )
        else false
      end
    else false
  end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.material_folder_standard_accessible(p_folder_id uuid, p_user_ref text DEFAULT current_ref())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  with recursive ancestors as (
    select mf.id, mf.parent_id, mf.access_standards, mf.name
    from public.material_folders mf
    where mf.id = p_folder_id
    union all
    select parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.access_standards, parent.name
    from public.material_folders parent
    join ancestors child on child.parent_id = parent.id
  ),
  student_standards as (
    select regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(s.cls, '')), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') as standard
    from public.students s
    where public.app_role() = 'student'
      and s.id = p_user_ref
    union
    select regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(s.cls, '')), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') as standard
    from public.students s
    join public.parent_student_links psl on psl.student_id = s.id
    where public.app_role() = 'parent'
      and psl.parent_auth_id = auth.uid()
      and psl.status = 'active'
    union
    select regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(s.cls, '')), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') as standard
    from public.students s
    where public.app_role() = 'parent'
      and s.id = p_user_ref
  )
  select
    public.app_role() in ('student', 'parent')
    and exists (
      select 1
      from ancestors a
      cross join student_standards ss
      where ss.standard <> ''
        and ss.standard = any(a.access_standards)
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.material_storage_object_readable(object_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select case
    when public.app_role() not in ('student','parent','teacher','admin') then false
    when public.app_role() = 'admin' then true
    when exists (
      select 1
      from public.materials m
      where m.storage_path = object_name
        and (
          (public.app_role() = 'teacher' and (
            m.tid = public.current_ref()
            or (m.folder_id is not null and public.teacher_material_folder_accessible(m.folder_id, public.current_ref()))
            or (m.folder_id is null and m.batch_id is not null and public.teacher_can_access_batch(m.batch_id, public.current_ref()))
          ))
          or (public.app_role() in ('student','parent') and (
            (m.folder_id is not null and public.material_folder_standard_accessible(m.folder_id, public.current_ref()))
            or (m.folder_id is null and public.material_row_readable(m.batch_id, m.cls, m.sec))
          ))
        )
    ) then true
    else false
  end;
$function$

AS $function$ declare existing_row public.timetable_entries%rowtype; names text[]; begin select * into existing_row from public.timetable_entries where batch_id=new.batch_id and teacher_id=new.teacher_id and day_of_week=new.day_of_week and status='active' and start_time=new.start_time and end_time=new.end_time and room_id is not distinct from new.room_id order by id limit 1; if existing_row.id is null then return new; end if; names := array(select distinct trim(x) from unnest(coalesce(existing_row.subject_names, string_to_array(existing_row.subject_name, ' + ')) || coalesce(new.subject_names, string_to_array(new.subject_name, ' + '))) as u(x) where nullif(trim(x),'') is not null order by trim(x)); update public.timetable_entries set subject_names=names, subject_name=array_to_string(names,' + ') where id=existing_row.id; return null; end; $function$

AS $function$ declare existing_id text; merged_names text[]; begin select id into existing_id from public.timetable_entries where id <> new.id and status = new.status and status = 'active' and batch_id = new.batch_id and teacher_id = new.teacher_id and academic_year_id is not distinct from new.academic_year_id and room_id is not distinct from new.room_id and day_of_week = new.day_of_week and start_time = new.start_time and end_time = new.end_time order by created_at, id limit 1; if existing_id is null then return new; end if; select array(select distinct trim(x) from unnest(coalesce((select subject_names from public.timetable_entries where id = existing_id), array[]::text[]) || coalesce(new.subject_names, array[]::text[])) as u(x) where nullif(trim(x), '') is not null order by trim(x)) into merged_names; update public.timetable_entries set subject_names = merged_names, subject_name = array_to_string(merged_names, ' + ') where id = existing_id; delete from public.timetable_entries where id = new.id; return new; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_timetable_subjects()
 RETURNS trigger

AS $function$ declare names text[]; begin if new.subject_names is not null then names := new.subject_names; elsif position(' + ' in coalesce(new.subject_name, '')) > 0 then names := string_to_array(new.subject_name, ' + '); else names := array[coalesce(new.subject_name, '')]; end if; names := array(select distinct trim(x) from unnest(names) as u(x) where nullif(trim(x), '') is not null order by trim(x)); if coalesce(array_length(names, 1), 0) = 0 then raise exception 'A timetable lecture requires at least one subject.' using errcode='23514'; end if; new.subject_names := names; new.subject_name := array_to_string(names, ' + '); return new; end; $function$

functions.name: prevent_timetable_conflict
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_timetable_conflict()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  -- Multiple batches may run at the same time in different rooms.
  -- The only scheduling conflict that must be blocked is assigning the same teacher
  -- to overlapping lessons on the same day.
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.timetable_entries x
    where x.id <> new.id
      and x.status = 'active'
      and new.status = 'active'
      and x.day_of_week = new.day_of_week
      and x.start_time < new.end_time
      and x.end_time > new.start_time
      and x.teacher_id = new.teacher_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'TIMETABLE_CONFLICT: this teacher already has an overlapping class on this day';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.student_can_access_batch(p_batch_id text, p_student_id text DEFAULT current_ref())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ select ((public.app_role()='student' and p_student_id=public.current_ref()) or (public.app_role()='parent' and public.parent_can_access_student(p_student_id))) and exists (select 1 from public.batch_students bs where bs.batch_id=p_batch_id and bs.student_id=p_student_id and coalesce(bs.status,'active')='active') $function$

functions.name: student_can_access_material
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.student_can_access_material(material_cls text, material_sec text, material_batch_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.students s
    where s.id = public.current_ref()
      and coalesce(s.status,'active') = 'active'
      and s.cls = material_cls
      and (material_sec is null or material_sec = '' or material_sec = s.sec)
  )
  or exists (
    select 1
    from public.parent_student_links psl
    join public.students s on s.id = psl.student_id
    where psl.parent_auth_id = auth.uid()
      and coalesce(psl.status,'active') = 'active'
      and coalesce(s.status,'active') = 'active'
      and s.cls = material_cls
      and (material_sec is null or material_sec = '' or material_sec = s.sec)
  )
  or public.app_role() = 'admin';
$function$

functions.name: student_can_access_material_folder
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.student_can_access_material_folder(p_folder_id uuid, p_student_id text DEFAULT current_ref())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  with recursive tree as (
    select mf.id, mf.parent_id, mf.name from public.material_folders mf where mf.id = p_folder_id
    union all select parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.name from public.material_folders parent join tree child on child.parent_id = parent.id
  ), descendants as (
    select mf.id from public.material_folders mf where mf.id = p_folder_id
    union all select child.id from public.material_folders child join descendants parent on child.parent_id = parent.id
  )
  select ((public.app_role()='student' and p_student_id=public.current_ref()) or (public.app_role()='parent' and public.parent_can_access_student(p_student_id)))
    and ( (public.app_role()='student' and exists (select 1 from public.students s join tree root on root.parent_id is null where s.id=p_student_id and root.name='Class ' || s.cls))
      or exists (select 1 from public.materials m join descendants d on d.id=m.folder_id where public.material_row_readable(m.batch_id,m.cls,m.sec)) );
$function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ begin if pg_trigger_depth() > 1 then return coalesce(new, old); end if; update public.batches b set studentids = coalesce((select array_agg(bs.student_id order by bs.joined_at, bs.student_id) from public.batch_students bs where bs.batch_id = b.id and bs.status = 'active' and bs.left_at is null), '{}'::text[]), "studentIds" = coalesce((select array_agg(bs.student_id order by bs.joined_at, bs.student_id) from public.batch_students bs where bs.batch_id = b.id and bs.status = 'active' and bs.left_at is null), '{}'::text[]), updated_at = now() where b.id = coalesce(new.batch_id, old.batch_id); return coalesce(new, old); end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_test_to_legacy_exam()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then delete from public.examschedule where id=old.id; return old; end if;
  insert into public.examschedule (id,title,subject,cls,sec,date,starttime,endtime,venue,syllabus,totalmarks,createdby,created_at,"startTime","endTime","totalMarks")
  select new.id,new.title,new.subject,b.cls,b.sec,new.test_date::text,null,null,null,new.description,new.total_marks::text,new.created_by,new.created_at,null,null,new.total_marks::text from public.batches b where b.id=new.batch_id
  on conflict (id) do update set title=excluded.title,subject=excluded.subject,cls=excluded.cls,sec=excluded.sec,date=excluded.date,syllabus=excluded.syllabus,totalmarks=excluded.totalmarks,createdby=excluded.createdby,created_at=excluded.created_at,"totalMarks"=excluded."totalMarks";
  return new;
end; $function$

functions.name: teacher_material_folder_accessible
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.teacher_material_folder_accessible(p_folder_id uuid, p_teacher_ref text DEFAULT current_ref())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with recursive ancestors as (
    select mf.id, mf.parent_id, mf.access_standards
    from public.material_folders mf
    where mf.id = p_folder_id
    union all
    select parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.access_standards
    from public.material_folders parent
    join ancestors child on child.parent_id = parent.id
  ),
  teacher_standards as (
    select distinct regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(b.cls, '')), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') as standard
    from public.batches b
    join public.timetable_entries te on te.batch_id = b.id
    where te.teacher_id = p_teacher_ref
      and te.status = 'active'
      and coalesce(b.status, 'active') = 'active'
      and regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(b.cls, '')), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') <> ''
  )
  select
    public.app_role() = 'teacher'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from ancestors a
      cross join teacher_standards ts
      where ts.standard = any(a.access_standards)
    );
$function$

functions.name: validate_batch_student_membership
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_batch_student_membership()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ declare b public.batches%rowtype; s public.students%rowtype; active_count integer; begin select * into b from public.batches where id = new.batch_id; if not found then raise exception 'BATCH_NOT_FOUND'; end if; select * into s from public.students where id = new.student_id; if not found then raise exception 'STUDENT_NOT_FOUND'; end if; if new.status = 'active' and new.left_at is null then if b.capacity is not null then select count(*) into active_count from public.batch_students bs where bs.batch_id = new.batch_id and bs.status = 'active' and bs.left_at is null and bs.student_id <> new.student_id; if active_count >= b.capacity then raise exception 'BATCH_CAPACITY_REACHED: batch % has reached its capacity of %', b.name, b.capacity; end if; end if; if b.cls is not null and b.cls <> '' and s.cls <> b.cls then raise exception 'BATCH_CLASS_MISMATCH: student class % does not match batch class %', s.cls, b.cls; end if; if b.sec is not null and b.sec <> '' and s.sec <> b.sec then raise exception 'BATCH_SECTION_MISMATCH: student section % does not match batch section %', s.sec, b.sec; end if; end if; return new; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_timetable_batch_year()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ declare batch_year text; begin select academic_year_id into batch_year from public.batches where id = new.batch_id; if batch_year is not null and new.academic_year_id is not null and batch_year <> new.academic_year_id then raise exception 'TIMETABLE_ACADEMIC_YEAR_MISMATCH'; end if; if new.academic_year_id is null then new.academic_year_id := batch_year; end if; return new; end; $function$
